tool_input.command: for f in package.json pigment.app.json index.html vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts README.md src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done

sed -i -e "s/style={PINK}/className=\"s-pink\"/g; s/style={PAPER}/className=\"s-paper\"/g; s/style={YELLOW}/className=\"s-yellow\"/g; s/style={RED}/className=\"s-red\"/g" -e "/^const \(PINK\|PAPER\|YELLOW\|RED\): CSSProperties/d" -e "/^import type { CSSProperties }/d" src/components/Sticker.tsx && grep -n "style\|CSSProp\|className=\"s-" src/components/Sticker.tsx | head
tool_input.description: Swap sticker inline fill styles for classes
